executives.subtitle: Executive Leadership
executives.title: Meet the Team Building a New Standard for Ethical Agribusiness
executives.description: Guided by the Islamic values of Amanah (sacred trust) and Ihsan (operational excellence), our leadership team brings together decades of experience in agribusiness, finance, technology, and community development. We are not just building a company — we are building a legacy of integrity, transparency, and shared prosperity.
executives.ctaTitle: Join Us in Shaping the Future of Ethical Agribusiness
executives.ctaDescription: We invite investors, partners, and distributors who share our values to connect with our leadership team.

ceo.title: Chief Executive Officer
ceo.alt: Hamza S. Ralsan Sangare, Founder & CEO of AfriNuts Export
bio: Hamza S. Ralsan Sangare is the Founder and CEO of AfriNuts Export, leading the company’s vision to build a vertically integrated, ethical cashew value chain rooted in Côte d’Ivoire. With three generations of family farming heritage in Odienné and a professional background in software engineering and project leadership, he combines tradition with modern execution.

Hamza applies a systems-driven approach to agribusiness, leveraging cloud technologies, digital platforms, and traceability tools to support scalable farm-to-export operations. He holds certifications in AWS Cloud, ITIL® 4, and CompTIA Project+, and applies Agile and service management principles across operations and strategic planning.

Under his leadership, AfriNuts is developing a 35-hectare regenerative cashew farm with a long-term vision for local processing, certified exports, and community-centered growth. Hamza is committed to building a business where Islamic values, transparency, and global quality standards converge—ensuring African agricultural value remains on the continent while serving international markets with integrity.
ceo.experience: 5+ years of leadership across agribusiness development, project execution, and technology-enabled operations.

cfo.title: Chief Financial & Operating Officer
cfo.role: Ethical Financial Architect & Value Chain Strategist
cfo.alt: Sekou Hakim, CFO of AfriNuts Export
bio: Sekou Hakim architects financial systems where profitability converges with prophetic principles, implementing Sharia-compliant frameworks that transform traditional agribusiness economics. His stewardship replaces extractive models with regenerative finance - where 20% of profits actively rebuild communities through wells, mosques, and farmer education.

As both financial guardian and operational strategist, Sekou oversees the complete monetization of our cashew value chain, from soil to shelf. He engineered the transition from raw commodity exports to in-country processing, designing capital structures that fund Odienné's first modern processing facility while maintaining rigorous profit-sharing (Mudarabah) standards.

Under his leadership, AfriNuts achieves the rare balance of fiscal discipline and social impact: deploying blockchain-enabled transparency for investors, fair trade premiums for farmers, and Islamic microfinancing for equipment - proving ethical finance can drive competitive advantage in global markets.

cco.title: Chief Commercial Officer
cco.alt: Portrait of Mohamadue Kouyaté, Chief Commercial Officer
bio: Muhamadue Kouyaté leads global commercial operations with a focus on ethical, interest-free business practices and strategic market expansion. Drawing on over a decade of experience in compliance, logistics, and operations, he builds sustainable trade partnerships and scalable processes rooted in transparency and integrity.

He oversees all export documentation, trade compliance, and buyer relationships — ensuring that every shipment meets international quality standards while adhering to Islamic finance principles. His logistics framework minimizes waste, maximizes efficiency, and guarantees traceability from farm to port.
cco.experience: 12+ years in operations management, supply chain logistics, and regulatory compliance.
education: Associate of Applied Science in Aviation Operations

ops.title: Chief Technology Officer
ops.role: Farm technology systems, IoT infrastructure, and data analytics
ops.alt: Portrait of Alassana Bah, Operations Manager
bio: Alassana Bah leads our technology infrastructure, implementing IoT sensors, farm management software, and data analytics to optimize cultivation and processing. Grounded in the Islamic principle of Ihsan (perfection in work), he ensures every system operates with precision and integrity.
ops.experience: 12+ years in software engineering, database management, and farm management information systems
education: B.Sc. in Computer Science or Information Technology
M.Sc. in Data Science or Agricultural Technology (in progress)

admin.title: Chief Administrative Officer
admin.role: Corporate governance, legal affairs, and human resources
admin.alt: Portrait of Mohammed Beniken, Administrative Manager
bio: Mohammed Beniken ensures organizational compliance with the Prophetic mandate for equitable labor practices, overseeing human resources, legal affairs, and information security protocols.

farm.title: Agricultural Operations Manager
farm.alt: Portrait of Souleymane Sangare, Farm Operations Manager
bio: Souleymane Sangare is the boots on the ground in Odienné. He manages daily farm operations, from land preparation and planting to irrigation and harvest. With 14 years of agricultural experience and deep roots in the local community, he serves as both cultivation specialist and primary liaison to local farmers, elders, and authorities.

He integrates traditional agricultural wisdom with modern organic farming techniques, ensuring our 35-hectare farm operates efficiently, ethically, and in harmony with the land. He also leads our community engagement efforts, including farmer training programs and the outgrower initiative that brings local smallholders into the AfriNuts supply chain.
